notes: The site type of the authored dungeons (Plan 6 D2; dungeons-1.json, dungeons-2.json). Weight 0: never drawn as an ordinary POI; world generation places each authored dungeon at most once as a POI of this type that names its dungeon, and its name, rooms and hoard come from there. Not hostile: a dungeon is a danger of its own and feeds no domain threat, but it cycles like any dungeon (cleared, empty, re-inhabited). Its one situation is only a fallback, played if its dungeon has gone from the content. Written by Claude.
